scenes.en: Counting down how tears protect your eyes
scenes.say: Did you know your tears have three layers? Let's count them down, and see how they protect your eyes.

scenes.en: From tiny glands on the lid edges. Stops tears drying too fast.
scenes.ta: எண்ணெய் அடுக்கு: கண்ணீர் விரைவில் காயாமல் தடுக்கும்
scenes.say: Number three. The oil layer on top. It comes from tiny glands along your eyelid edges, and stops tears from drying too fast.

scenes.en: From the tear glands. Washes away dust and germs.
scenes.say: Number two. The watery middle layer. It comes from the tear glands, washes away dust and germs, and keeps the front of the eye nourished.

scenes.en: Helps tears spread and stick evenly on the eye
scenes.ta: கண்ணீரை கண்ணின் மேல் சீராகப் பரவச் செய்யும்
scenes.say: Number one. The mucus layer, closest to the eye. It helps tears spread and stick evenly over the eye's surface.

scenes.en: Studies show we blink less when staring at screens
scenes.say: Every blink spreads a fresh layer of tears. But studies show we blink much less when staring at screens, so the eyes feel dry and gritty.

scenes.en: Blink fully. 20-20-20 breaks. Keep AC and fan air off your face. Drink water.
scenes.say: Protect your tears. Blink fully, take twenty twenty twenty breaks, keep fan air off your face, and drink enough water.

scenes.en: Painful red eye, or vision suddenly blurs. For ongoing dryness, book an eye test.
scenes.say: See an eye specialist urgently if you have a painful red eye, or your vision suddenly blurs. For ongoing dryness, book an eye test.
